project.name: Destiny OS :: AI Narrative
project.description: Phase 12: the AI narrative layer (AI_NARRATIVE_SPEC.md, ADR D8). Depends only on destiny-core - never on destiny-fusion, destiny-scenario, or any destiny-engine-* module (enforced in destiny-app's ArchitectureRulesTest, same pattern as ADR D5 for destiny-fusion). This is deliberate: nothing upstream of this module depends on it either (D8 - "AI is a non-blocking optional stage"), so the whole system must remain fully usable with this module absent, disabled, or failing. Callers (destiny-api) build a NarrativeInput from already Vietnamese-labeled data and get back either a real AI narrative or a deterministic hard-data fallback - never an exception, never a fabricated result, never a blocked request.
